name: Running Late
source:
Running Late is a mystery visual novel (no choices) where you are approached by a mysterious girl while waiting for your girlfriend who's running late.

This story treats you as intelligent and doesn't hold your hand. You'll have all the pieces to make sense of the mystery yourself. Best of luck!

[from [url=https://goldbargames.itch.io/running-late]itch.io[/url]]
